scope: Paired system/configuration comparison: frozen v1 versus repaired model/reset/servo bundle; not an isolated controller effect

target_selection.rule: 1 + original split-list index modulo 2; subset replay preserves original index
target_selection.grounding: SimGrounder exact unique object name, asserted before scoring

success.predicate: Post-action EE-site distance to current named target body center strictly below 0.03m
success.initially_satisfied: Zero actions, no success credit, retained in full denominator
success.stopping: First qualifying hit, environment termination/truncation, or 200 steps
success.limitations: Instantaneous proximity; no orientation, secure grasp, dwell, stable placement, stationary-target or physical-robot claim

pairing.common: Ordered object identities, initial pose/velocity, compiled size/mass/inertia/material/contact parameters, selected target identity, and shared table/floor geometry, gravity, timestep and solver settings
pairing.variant_specific: Full arm state, actuator settings, contact geometry, home configuration and model hash are retained separately; full initial-state equality is not claimed
pairing.no_resampling: All declared scenes remain; no filtering by reachability, contact, displacement or outcome

analysis.primary: Paired success count and descriptive success-rate difference, repaired minus frozen
analysis.marginal_interval: Wilson 95% endpoints, z=1.96, per variant/full denominator
analysis.interpretation: No inference of one-component causality; marginal Wilson intervals are not a paired-effect confidence interval

trace: Per-step actions/live EE/target/object0 geometry; arm qpos/qvel, actuator targets and generalized forces, acceleration, contacts and simulation time
freeze_rule: Commit final implementation/protocol before evaluating either variant on any held-out seed. Require a clean recorded revision. No tuning after outcomes; replay is not another independent sample.

diagnostics.forces: Generalized force components are recorded separately; do not sum qfrc_passive and qfrc_gravcomp without accounting for their inclusion semantics
diagnostics.contacts: Each contact records geom IDs, signed distance and the six-dimensional force/torque in the contact frame; geom names are retained with each model snapshot
diagnostics.optional: arm_qfrc_gravcomp is null only when unavailable in the installed simulator
diagnostics.failure: On numerical/execution failure, retain an aborted partial artifact with failed seed/variant and no aggregate summary; no resampling or success credit
